def: to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart)

occurrences.text: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
